_meta.note: Illustrative stress-scenario library. Shocks are defined at FULL severity (impact score = 10) and scaled linearly by impact/10. Orders of magnitude are loosely inspired by historical episodes (2008 credit crisis, 2020 pandemic sell-off, 2022 rate shock, 2022 energy/geopolitical shock, 2023 regional-bank stress) - they are NOT regulatory calibrations (CCAR/EBA/ICAAP).

Geopolitical.description: Military / sanctions / shipping-lane shock: flight to quality, energy spike, risk-off

Macroeconomic.description: Surprise monetary tightening / inflation shock: rates up, valuations and real estate hit

Credit Event.description: Bank failure / sovereign or large-corporate default: funding stress, spread blow-out, contagion

Operational/Cyber.description: Systemic cyber / payments-infrastructure outage: operational loss and confidence shock

Natural Disaster/Pandemic.description: Catastrophe / pandemic: demand collapse in travel and cyclicals, defensive rotation

Regulatory/Legal.description: Sector-wide regulatory action (antitrust / privacy / conduct): contained equity and spread impact
